                    STATE OF FLORIDA
        PUBLIC EMPLOYEES RELATIONS COMMISSION

CITY OF EXAMPLE,
              Public Employer,
    and                                    Case No. RC-2011-032
AFSCME FLORIDA COUNCIL 79,
              Petitioner.

                CERTIFICATION OF REPRESENTATIVE

A secret ballot election having been conducted, the Commission certifies
AFSCME Florida Council 79 as the exclusive bargaining representative of
the unit described in the petition.

DATED this June 14, 2011, at Tallahassee, Florida.
